about: Recorded-response fixture for the Day-5 agent's demo fallback (spec test 12): prompt -> the model's intent reply, replayed by RecordedClient under the same propose-confirm gate.

exchanges.prompt: Invoice Acme for the 40 units we shipped Tuesday.

note: Re-recorded LIVE on 2026-10-31 from Baseten meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026 (Meta hackathon grant via the custom.baseten connector route; HTTP 200, 1561 tokens). The reply validates against the same intent schema the adapter enforces (invoice_shipment / Acme / qty 40 / Tuesday) and drives the adapter to a byte-identical proposal as the stub parse. The previous stub-recorded fixture is preserved as recorded_t1_stub.json.
